text: A small brass pressure canister thrown through the air: one quick whoosh with a short soft hiss of steam escaping behind it, low, not shrill, dry, no reverb, no music.
A small metal canister lobbed like a grenade: a crisp metallic ping of a released safety lever, then a short tumbling whoosh through the air. Realistic, dry, no reverb, no explosion, no music.
A low electric charge building up for a moment, then a deep concussive thump that collapses inward with a short rush of air, like an implosion. Realistic, not shrill, no music.
A heavy rugged push button on a dusty old machine pressed hard: one deep dull clunk with a faint gritty scrape of sand in the mechanism, low pitched, dry, no reverb.
An arming switch: a hard plastic safety cover flipped open and one solid click, then a short low electric hum, not shrill, not a beep, dry, no reverb.
